headline: Wardens Reclaim Northern Ground as Frontline Clashes Shake Callahan's Passage
war_summary: Warden arms have reversed recent setbacks across the northern theater, clearing Colonial footholds in Callahan’s Passage to secure nine garrisons alongside a single neutral ruin after five sharp base exchanges over the past two hours. In Palantine Berm, Warden forces similarly swept the board, restoring complete control over all seven sector bases despite ongoing skirmishes around The Pippeli Stones and Leiri Hermanni. Further west, Nevish Line recorded three fresh base turnovers, widening Warden control to six strongpoints against two Colonial positions. Strategic movements have also reawakened in Weathered Expanse, where three base changes struck during the last two hours amidst punishing artillery duels that inflicted over six hundred casualties, leaving Colonials holding seven bases to the Wardens' two. Stlican Shelf broke its earlier lull with two base shifts centered on Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, keeping the sector partitioned six to two in Colonial favor with one site neutralized. Meanwhile, the contest in Mooring County has cooled to a standstill, logging no base transfers in two hours as the lone Colonial enclave endures.
